capture_basis.observed_at_semantics: Internet Archive capture timestamp; not asserted retailer price-change time
capture_basis.acquisition_method: archived retailer category/listing pages; identity, capacity and module count read from visible labelled fields, never from URL slugs or part-number naming conventions
capture_basis.sampling_caveat: A category-page capture contributes many products at one instant while a product-page capture contributes one. Period breadth counts must be read alongside any envelope derived from this tranche.
